versions.changelog: Add media downloading support: list media in threads, download by URL/media-ID, download-all from thread. Messages and wall posts now include media attachment metadata (photos, audio, video). Wall/feed posts also expose media arrays.
Moved htmlformdef.js API reference to Confluence; removed references/ directory from published skill to reduce package size by ~559KB
Added meal planning and recipe management
Initial release: calendar events, shopping/task lists, messaging, location, and wall/feed
